purpose: Additional skeptical counterexample search for same-guide low-contrast boundaries; no candidate tuning
scope: Follow-up outside the original frozen heldout quality set. Does not replace, modify, or retrofit the original acceptance thresholds.
target_right: exact original raw right RGB words
normalization: Every palette colour is normalized to identical per-lobe luminance using (0.2126,0.7152,0.0722) BEFORE RNE half input storage.

metrics: Immutable unchanged-right4px band, max and mean L1 RGB change divided by original raw luma; original local half storage envelope and exact word gate unchanged.
